title: IB Exam Builder: Create a Custom Paper in 5 Minutes
summary: Use the RevisionDojo IB exam builder to create a targeted practice paper by subject, level, topic and difficulty, then complete it online or print it.
body_markdown:
An **IB exam builder** converts a broad question bank into a targeted practice paper. With RevisionDojo, you can select a subject, level, paper, topics, difficulty and question count, then complete the test online or download printable materials.


The builder connects with the[IB Question Bank](https://www.revisiondojo.com/features/questionbank) , Exam Mode, Study Notes and Jojo AI. It is particularly useful for addressing specific weaknesses, although official and school-provided papers remain essential for rehearsing complete examination formats.


### What the RevisionDojo IB exam builder does


The[RevisionDojo Exam Builder](https://www.revisiondojo.com/exam-builder) creates custom tests from IB-style questions matching your chosen filters. Instead of completing an entire paper to practise one weak area, you can isolate the content and question types that need attention.


Depending on the course, you can configure:


- **IB subject and course** , such as Mathematics AA or Chemistry
- **SL or HL**
- **Paper or assessment component**
- **Topics and subtopics**
- **Difficulty and question count**
- **Online or printable delivery**


The builder is an assessment generator, not a prediction engine. It creates relevant practice but cannot determine exactly what will appear in an official examination.


### Build a custom IB exam in 5 minutes


Five minutes is a realistic setup target once you know what you need to practise. The process may take longer when you are learning the interface or checking several filters.


### 1. Choose a subject and objective


Open the[IB exam builder](https://www.revisiondojo.com/exam-builder) and select your subject. If its syllabus has recently changed, confirm that you are using the relevant course version.


Set a precise objective rather than choosing questions at random. For example, replace “revise Chemistry” with “test whether I can apply equilibrium concepts without notes.”


### 2. Confirm the level and paper


Select **SL or HL** and the relevant paper or component. HL courses may contain additional content, greater depth or different assessment demands, so choosing the wrong level can make the results misleading.


Match the paper to the skill being tested. If an upcoming school assessment covers one component, practise that format instead of mixing unrelated question types.


### 3. Select topics and subtopics


Choose one weak topic for diagnosis or several topics for mixed retrieval. A Biology test might focus on cell respiration, while a Mathematics AA test could combine functions, calculus and probability.


Avoid selecting the whole syllabus automatically. Topic filtering is valuable because it lets you respond directly to marked work, teacher feedback or patterns recorded in RevisionDojo's[Mistakes Log and study features](https://www.revisiondojo.com/features) .


### 4. Set difficulty and size


Choose a level that creates useful struggle without making the test inaccessible. Start with standard questions if your method is unreliable. Once routine questions are secure, introduce harder problems requiring unfamiliar application.


Practice goal Suggested build


Quick diagnosis One topic and a few questions


Method practice One or two topics with increasing difficulty


Mixed retrieval Several previously studied topics


Exam rehearsal Broad coverage, the correct paper and a strict timer


These are study recommendations, not official IB requirements. The appropriate length depends on the subject, available time and assessment being prepared for.


### 5. Generate, check and export


Generate the paper and check that the questions match your objective. You can complete it online in timed Exam Mode or download the **question paper** , **markscheme** or both.


Printing helps you practise handwriting, diagrams, page management and uninterrupted concentration. Online completion is more convenient when you want rapid feedback and access to Jojo AI explanations.

### How to use Jojo AI after the test


The builder reveals what you can do under test conditions. **Jojo AI** is most useful after an independent attempt, when it can help explain why marks were lost.


Classify each mistake as missing knowledge, faulty reasoning, misreading, weak command-term use, incomplete working or poor time management. Then ask a focused question, such as: “I chose the correct formula but substituted the wrong quantity. Which clue should have guided me?”


After reading the explanation, close it and repeat the question unaided. Use[Study Notes, Flashcards and Jojo AI](https://www.revisiondojo.com/blog/meet-jojo-ai-your-personal-ib-study-assistant-that-changes-the-game) to repair the weakness before generating a fresh test.


### Exam builders versus paper-only revision


Generated tests and traditional papers solve different revision problems. A strong plan uses both.


Method Main strength Main limitation


Automated exam builder Targets chosen topics and difficulties quickly May not reproduce a complete official paper's balance


Official or school-provided paper Rehearses authentic structure, pacing and concentration Makes isolating one weakness slower


Online Exam Mode Adds timing and faster feedback Cannot reproduce every handwritten examination condition


Topic question bank Provides concentrated repetition Topic labels can reveal the required method


The IB states that written examinations form the basis of assessment in most Diploma Programme courses. Targeted practice should therefore progress toward[official sample papers](https://ibo.org/programmes/diploma-programme/assessment-and-exams/sample-exam-papers/) and full timed rehearsals.


### RevisionDojo compared with Revision Village


Revision Village also offers **Build My Exam** . Its documentation describes controls for topics, difficulty, marks ranges, papers and question types, followed by study or exam modes. RevisionDojo is not the only platform providing automated test construction.


RevisionDojo's distinguishing feature is its connected workflow. Students can build and complete a paper, review feedback, consult Jojo AI, revisit Study Notes and return to targeted practice within one IB-focused environment. The better platform still depends on current subject coverage, preferred explanations and required tools.


### Updates and troubleshooting


RevisionDojo's public documentation confirms configurable tests, timed online practice and printable output. Its[download guidance](https://www.revisiondojo.com/help-center/downloading-and-printing) states that saved papers can be exported as a question paper, markscheme or combined package. A detailed public engineering changelog for builder-specific fixes could not be verified, so individual reliability or filtering updates should not be claimed without product-team confirmation.


If generation or export fails:


1. Check the subject, level, paper and topic selections.
2. Refresh the page and try a smaller test.
3. Allow downloads and pop-ups in your browser.
4. Try an updated alternative browser.
5. Record the filters used and take a screenshot before contacting support.


### A practical weekly routine


Build one narrow diagnostic test, complete it without notes and classify every lost mark. Repair the underlying gap, then attempt fresh questions rather than memorising previous answers.


End the week with a broader timed paper. This prevents overreliance on topic labels and tests whether you can recognise the required method independently.


### Conclusion


The RevisionDojo IB exam builder creates focused papers using subject, level, paper, topic, difficulty and size controls. Use generated tests for targeted correction, then official or school-provided papers for complete exam rehearsal. RevisionDojo's Question Bank and Jojo AI can support the testing, feedback and reteaching cycle.
